name: CallProof Complaint Evidence Packet
problem: Organize a user's own unwanted-call or text records and evidence into a factual packet for review before optional FCC or FTC filing.
use_when: turn my call log into a complaint packet
inputs: Authenticated user-owned incident records, with optional contact details, notes and evidence references.
outputs: Downloadable factual incident packet. CallProof does not file the complaint or determine that a law was violated.
pricing: Published app pricing: $19 one-time packet, $7.99/month Vault, $29/month Pro. Live Stripe checkout price is authoritative.
confirmation: User authentication and explicit checkout action are required. Paid access is granted only after Stripe verification.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
